name: Order, badge or star
definition: insignia of an order of chivalry or merit (badge, star, collar or sash badge).
notes: Noonans catalogue lists single orders (K.P., CMG, OBE, St John badges); breast and neck badges sold

name: Gallantry decoration
definition: decoration awarded for a specific act of gallantry or distinguished service.
notes: Noonans heading Groups and Single Decorations for Gallantry; VC and GC sold at auction

name: Campaign medal
definition: medal awarded for service in a named campaign or operation.
notes: Baldwin sells single campaign medals with clasps

name: Long-service and good-conduct medal
definition: medal awarded for a length of service or record of conduct.
notes: Baldwin long service medals: LS&GC, Meritorious Service Medal; minimum 18 years stated

name: Commemorative medal
definition: medal struck to mark an event, person or anniversary, such as a coronation, jubilee, birth or visit.
notes: Numista types: Commemorative medals incl. personality, company, event medals

name: Art medal
definition: medal or plaquette struck or cast as a work of medallic art.
notes: Numista medal type Art medals

name: Souvenir medal or elongated coin
definition: souvenir piece struck or rolled for a place or event, including a coin rolled out with a new design.
notes: Numista type Souvenir medallions > Elongated coins; elongated coin is a flattened embossed coin

name: Award medal
definition: disc medal given for achievement in sport, school, military or other competition, sports finisher's medals included (F3-O2).
notes: Numista Award medals (sport, scholastic, military, civic); Crown Awards sells place medals

name: Challenge coin or membership medal
definition: coin-shaped medal issued to members of a unit, club or organisation.
notes: Signature Coins sells unit challenge coins; Numista type Membership medals > Challenge coins

name: Mace
definition: ceremonial staff carried as insignia of a parliamentary, civic, academic or judicial office.
notes: Council pages show civic maces; no shop page for mace

name: Gavel
definition: mallet used as insignia of a presiding office.
notes: Shop sells director gavel sets with sounding block; presiding-office use not stated

name: Cup trophy
definition: cup-shaped trophy on a base, perpetual cups included.
notes: Trophy Cups category; cup trophies incl. perpetual rosebowl cup

name: Shield
definition: shield-shaped award, usually with plates for engraved names.
notes: Metal Shields under Shields & Plaques

name: Plaque
definition: flat award panel with an inscription, made to hang or stand.
notes: Wooden, resin plaques; sport and corporate plaques

name: Upright award
definition: column, figure, star, block or obelisk award on a base.
notes: Column trophies, star insert trophies, sculpture trophies

name: Bowl, tankard or salver
definition: bowl, tankard, tray or salver given as an award.
notes: Silverware & Bowls: tankards, salvers, trays, rosebowls

name: Rosette or ribbon
definition: rosette or ribbon given as an award.
notes: Rosette award ribbons sold by Hodges Badge

name: Championship belt
definition: belt awarded to a champion (K-119).
notes: Crown Awards category Championship Belts

name: Championship ring
definition: ring awarded to the members of a championship team or to a champion (K-119).
notes: Championship Rings, gold and silver deluxe rings

name: Base card
definition: standard card of a numbered sports or non-sports series issued by a card manufacturer.
notes: 2026 Topps Chrome Baseball: 300 base cards

name: Insert or autograph card
definition: card inserted at a lower rate than the base set, including signed and relic cards.
notes: Same set: 833 inserts, 462 autograph and 9 relic cards

name: Product-issued card
definition: card printed on the box, panel or packaging of another product and cut from it (hand-cut cards).
notes: PSA grades cards hand-cut from panel or box (Post Cereal, Hostess, Bazooka)

name: Collectible sticker
definition: sticker of a numbered series of the Panini type made to be collected into an album (K-121).
notes: Panini 2026 FIFA World Cup sticker album; packs of 7 stickers sold separately

name: Sealed card product
definition: unopened pack, box, blaster, hanger or case of cards, with `product_form` an attribute.
notes: Page covers hobby box, blaster, mega, hanger, fat pack, pack; case not defined

name: Coin capsule or holder
definition: capsule, flip or holder made to hold one coin or note.
notes: APMEX category Coin & Bar Capsules; Air-Tite direct fit capsule

name: Grading slab
definition: sealed holder in which a grader encapsulates one coin, note or card.
notes: Slab is a holder for a coin graded by PCGS, NGC; PSA encapsulates cards

name: Stamp hinge or mount
definition: hinge or clear mount made to fix one stamp in place.
notes: Stamp Mounts (Prinz/Scott, Hawid, Showgard) and separate Stamp Hinges category

name: Medal bar or ribbon bar
definition: bar on which medals or their ribbons are mounted for wear.
notes: London Medal Co sells tunic medal ribbon bars; German dealer lists Ordenspangen und Bandspangen

name: Medal ribbon
definition: length of ribbon made for one medal or decoration.
notes: Replacement medal ribbons supplied; listing WW1 Victory Medal ribbon

name: Medal case
definition: case made to hold one medal or decoration.
notes: US Mint presentation case holds one 3-inch medal

name: Card toploader or sleeve
definition: rigid toploader or soft sleeve made to hold one card.
notes: Ultra Pro 3x4 toploaders for standard cards; penny sleeves
